def forward(groups):
    month, sp1, day, sp2, time = groups
    text = month + ' ' + day.zfill(2) + ' ' + time
    dt = datetime.strptime(text, '%b %d %H:%M:%S')
    return {'stored': [dt.month * 10000000000 + dt.day * 100000000 + dt.hour * 1000000 + dt.minute * 10000 + dt.second * 100], 'layout': [len(sp1), len(sp2), len(day)]}

def inverse(record):
    stored = record['stored'][0]
    layout = record['layout']
    sp1, sp2, day_width = layout
    month = stored // 10000000000
    day = (stored % 10000000000) // 100000000
    hour = (stored % 100000000) // 1000000
    minute = (stored % 1000000) // 10000
    second = (stored % 10000) // 100
    month_text = datetime(1900, month, 1).strftime('%b')
    day_text = str(day).zfill(day_width)
    time_text = f'{hour:02}:{minute:02}:{second:02}'
    return month_text + (' ' * sp1) + day_text + (' ' * sp2) + time_text
